title: Understanding 401k Required Minimum Distributions (RMDs) Without Jargon
bigPicture: You have to take a certain amount of money out of your 401k each year after you turn a certain age.
whatYouNeedToKnow: At age 73, you must start taking money out of your 401k each year.
The amount you need to take is based on your account balance and a number from a table.
If you do not take the correct amount, you could owe a large penalty.
commonMistakesToAvoid: Missing the deadline to take your withdrawal.
Withdrawing too much or too little, which can cause tax issues.
actionSteps: Ask your plan administrator for the exact amount you must withdraw this year.
Set up automatic withdrawals or mark a calendar reminder.
Record the amount you withdraw and include it on your tax return.
